name: pharmaagent-health-assistant
description: Health information assistant for employees. Scope control and PII redaction ONLY -- clinical safety (escalation, severity, the 'not documented is not safe' contract) is enforced in Python, not here.

topicsConfig.name: Diagnosis
topicsConfig.definition: Requests to identify, confirm or rule out what disease or condition a person has, based on their symptoms, history or test results. Explaining what a named condition is, is NOT diagnosis and is in scope.
examples: What disease do I have?
Based on these symptoms, is it dengue or typhoid?
Do I have diabetes?
Is this cancer?
Tell me what's wrong with me

topicsConfig.name: Prescribing and dose changes
topicsConfig.definition: Recommending that a person start, stop, switch or change the dose of a medicine, including medicines a clinician has already prescribed them. Reporting the dosing text printed on an official product label is NOT prescribing and is in scope.
examples: Should I stop taking my blood pressure tablets?
Can I double my dose since it isn't working?
Which antibiotic should I take for this?
Is it okay to skip my thyroid medicine this week?
Prescribe me something for the pain

topicsConfig.name: Self-harm methods
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for information that would help a person harm or kill themselves -- lethal doses, which medicines are fatal in overdose, how much of something is required to cause death. A person EXPRESSING distress or suicidal feelings is not this topic and must be answered with crisis support.
examples: How many tablets would be a lethal dose?
Which medicine is the most painless way to die?
What is the fatal amount of paracetamol?
How much insulin would kill someone?

topicsConfig.name: Obtaining medicines without a prescription
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for help acquiring prescription-only or controlled medicines outside a lawful prescription, including where to buy them, how to obtain them without a doctor, or how to get a prescription issued under false pretences.
examples: Where can I buy tramadol without a prescription?
How do I get alprazolam without seeing a doctor?
Which pharmacy will sell antibiotics without a prescription?
What should I tell a doctor to get sleeping pills?

topicsConfig.name: Fitness for duty and medical certificates
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for a sick note, medical certificate, fitness-for-work opinion, or a statement about whether a person is fit to work, drive or travel. This system is provided by an employer and must not produce employment-relevant medical opinions about anyone.
examples: Write me a sick note for two days
Am I fit to return to work?
Can you certify that I was unwell?
Am I fit to drive on these tablets?

topicsConfig.name: Medical advice about another person
topicsConfig.definition: Requests for assessment, triage or advice concerning a specific other person -- a colleague, family member or child -- rather than the person asking. General information about a condition or medicine is in scope regardless of who it is for.
examples: My daughter has a fever of 39, what should I give her?
My colleague is on lithium, is he safe to work?
My father collapsed, what should we do at home?
How much of this should I give my 3-year-old?

blockedInputMessaging: I can't help with that one. I can explain what a medicine or condition is, check whether an interaction is documented, and read lab results -- but I can't diagnose, recommend or change treatment, or give an opinion about someone else. For anything in that territory, please speak to a doctor or pharmacist. If this is urgent, call 112.
